task.title: N7.3: package the N7.1a-selected OCR engine and English data with a pinned local asset manifest
task.objective: Pin exactly the qualified direct tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 SIMD LSTM files and the @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 best_int data in src/offline/ocr-runtime.json, stage them with prepare-ocr-assets.mjs into build/ocr (shipped to resources/ocr by electron-builder), fold the staged manifest into the signed dependency manifest, validate it against the pin in validate-offline-bundle.ps1, stage it in both packaging scripts inside the existing progress step, and add the third-party notice. Nothing is downloaded, no product dependency is added, OCR stays optional and default-off, and the packaged load (N7.1b) and strict release validation stay BLOCKED until a packaging run on the approved host.

acceptance.description: The pin equals the N7.1a decision, staging reproduces exactly the qualified bytes within the OC-9 size target and refuses tampered or missing inputs, and the packaging scripts, manifest generator, offline validator and notices carry the OCR assets; packaged evidence stays BLOCKED until a real packaging run.

evidence.observed: 45/0: pin equals the N7.1a GO and the qualifying run's hashes and lockfile integrity, staging byte-identical and deterministic at 5961021 bytes within the 8000000 target, tampered, missing, wrong-version, occupied and in-repo outputs refused, wiring in electron-builder, both packaging scripts, the manifest generator and the validator, four PowerShell scripts parse, notices present

non-strict run passed; the new OCR section warns that the committed signed manifest does not carry ocrRuntime yet, as expected before a packaging run. Strict validation of a real release is carried by N7.1b and is BLOCKED (no approved packaging host)

history.released_reason: N7.3 protected wiring written: OCR pin, electron-builder extraResources build/ocr to resources/ocr, OCR staging in both packaging scripts, ocrRuntime in the manifest generator, third-party notice
